name: Saint Thomas Becket
history: Chancellor and friend of King Henry II, Thomas became Archbishop of Canterbury and defended the freedom of the Church against the king. Four knights murdered him in his own cathedral. Canterbury became one of the great pilgrim shrines of Europe.
meditation: Willing to die for the Church: what would you be willing to give up for her?
